verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents 700+ connectors and a dedicated destinations catalog explicitly covering major warehouses/lakes (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres) and object storage/open table format lake support, with connectors handling schema drift and incremental syncs automatically so pipeline logic doesn't change per destination. Community feedback confirms reliability of syncing as a core strength, though pricing/API reliability complaints are unrelated to portability itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of switching destinations without pipeline changes, and more detail on parity of features across all destination types.
